items.question: How many fils make up one UAE dirham?
items.gold: The dirham is subdivided into 100 fils.

items.question: What minimum fine does UAE law set for publicly and intentionally destroying currency under Article 173 of Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025?
items.gold: A fine of not less than 10,000 Dirhams, alone or with imprisonment.
items.fact: Article 173 minimum fine for destroying currency publicly.
